current.label: v0.6.0 — Refunds: refundInvoice() + Refunded enum + payments mapping for exact merchantPayout/fee tracking
changes: InvoiceStatus enum gains Refunded (= 3); existing None/Created/Paid values unchanged
payments[globalId] mapping records exact (merchantPayout, fee) at pay() time so refundInvoice() doesn't have to re-derive them from oracle math

refundInvoice(bytes32) external nonReentrant: pulls merchantPayout from merchant via transferFrom (requires payoutToken approve to gateway), forwards to inv.paidBy, returns the protocol fee from accrued back to merchant. Callable by merchant or owner.
InvoiceRefunded event with (globalId, refundedTo, payoutToken, merchantPayout, protocolFeeReturned)
Errors: InvoiceNotRefundable, InsufficientFeesForRefund (when owner already withdrew accrued fees)

deprecated_v0.5.0.label: v0.5.0 — Iterating _estimateAmountIn (1-wei swap shortfall fix)
deprecated_v0.5.0.reason: Replaced by v0.6.0 which adds refundInvoice() + payments mapping. v0.5 kept on-chain for any in-flight settlements but superseded for new merchant onboarding.

deprecated_v0.4.0.label: v0.4.0 — Gateway v2 (namespacing + merchant updates + same-token + event split)
deprecated_v0.4.0.reason: Replaced by v0.5.0 to fix _estimateAmountIn 1-wei shortfall that broke EURC↔USDC swap pay() in production.
changes: createInvoice/createInvoiceFor take merchantInvoiceId; contract derives globalId = keccak256(merchant, merchantInvoiceId)
Merchant struct gains payoutAddress (separate from msg.sender) and active flag; updatePayoutAddress, updatePayoutToken, deactivateMerchant added
pay() takes a no-swap branch when payIn == payoutToken (same-token direct payment)
InvoicePaid event split: 6 fields (id, payer, amountIn, grossReceived, merchantPayout, fee)
Invoice locks payoutToken at creation; later merchant updates do not reroute pending invoices

smokeTest_pay.note: Real 1.0863 EUR/USD, no parity hack. 0.1 EURC → 0.108587 USDC.

deprecated_v0.1.0.label: Plan 1 — Saddle StableSwap (replaced; left here for reference)
deprecated_v0.1.0.reason: StableSwap invariant assumes 1:1 peg between pooled tokens. With USDC/EURC at 1.0863 USD/EUR, the pool's implied rate stayed near 1:1 regardless of bootstrap balances, forcing the oracle to be set to parity to pass the deviation guard. Replaced in Plan 1.5 by OracleAMM (Chainlink-priced, no curve) which trades at the live oracle rate ± a 4 bps fee.
